Sprint

what the design engine answered

Same 80 mm envelope, same 48 V rail. Give the design engine a different task and it answers with a different motor. Impulse tasks like the jump and the sprint get few-turn, thin-iron windings that dump a peak and cool off. Continuous tasks like the carry and the pick get many turns, thick iron, and a taller gear stack to hold torque without overheating. The highlighted rows are the ones that moved.
